observation.command:
echo "=== Container state ==="
docker ps --filter name=openproject --format 'name={{.Names}} image={{.Image}} status={{.Status}} ports={{.Ports}}'
echo "=== HTTP endpoints ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /        -> %{http_code} (redirect: %{redirect_url})\n" http://localhost:8080/
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /login   -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/login
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /health_check -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/health_check
echo "=== Version / seed evidence ==="
docker logs openproject 2>&1 | grep -E "Seeding admin user|default admin credentials" | head
docker exec openproject bash -c 'cd /app && bundle exec rails runner "puts %q(version=)+OpenProject::VERSION.to_s; puts %q(users=)+User.count.to_s"' 2>&1 | grep -E "version=|users="
echo "=== Persistent volumes ==="
docker inspect openproject --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}} -> {{.Destination}}{{"\n"}}{{end}}'
ls -la /var/lib/openproject/pgdata | head -3
